claims: Bitcoin ATMs are kiosks for buying/selling crypto with cash.
Crypto miners are hardware for generating cryptocurrency.
Bitcoin ATMs allow instant cash-to-crypto transactions.
Mining rigs use ASIC chips to solve complex mathematical problems to earn rewards.
Mining rigs range from large industrial rigs to small home units.
Bitcoin ATMs allow users to buy Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies with cash/debit cards.
Bitcoin ATMs allow users to sell Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies for cash.
ASIC miners are dedicated hardware used to mine Bitcoin using the SHA-256 algorithm.
The Avalon series are large-scale ASIC miner rigs.
The Lucky miner LV07 is a compact home miner.
The NerdMiner V2 is a mini device that allows individuals to participate in solo mining.
Bitaxe is a mini device that allows individuals to participate in solo mining.
Solo mining involves trying to win a full block reward.
